Copy your existing website image files into this folder using these filenames:
- exhibit.jpg
- blessing.jpg
- ceofounder.jpg
- mercy.jpeg
- haddasah.jpg

Optional work-preview screenshots:
- young-and-gifted.jpg
- v3cares-project.jpg
- portfolio-project.jpg

The components have designed fallback artwork if an image is missing. Update the project names and links in src/components/WorkPreview.jsx to match your real portfolio projects.
